title: Error on update & open config
summary: Settings and tray Update fail to open; supplied diagnostics show Settings crashes. A contributor's current Windows-up-to-date question is unanswered.
next_action: Wait for the reporter to answer the existing Windows-up-to-date question; do not repeat it or request another diagnostic ZIP.

evidence: The report describes failures opening Settings and starting an update from the tray while Exit still works; it includes Windows Error Reporting data for PowerToys.Settings.exe on 0.102.3001.0.
The latest discussion activity is a contributor's unanswered question asking whether Windows is up to date: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/52198#issuecomment-7005946012.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the reporter's answer to the current Windows-up-to-date question, then reassess whether Settings still crashes and whether the Update action fails through the same path.

actions.label: Separate Settings startup failure from tray update failure

reproduce.title: Trace the Settings and Update tray commands independently
reproduce.version_requirement: PowerToys 0.102.3001.0; compare with the latest supported stable release
prerequisites: Disposable Windows environment and the reporter-provided diagnostics.
setup: Match the reported OS build where practical. Run each tray action in a separate attempt and record its timestamp.
steps: Open Settings via the tray menu and correlate its process launch and any exit with the Settings log.
Repeat for the tray Update command; note whether it reaches Settings startup, begins an update, or fails earlier.
Compare clean-profile and update-install results; correlate any failures with the existing Windows error summary.
reproduce.expected_result: Settings opens from each supported entry point. If an entry point fails, its first failing operation and whether it shares the normal startup failure are identified.

issue_context.summary: Settings and Update fail from the tray while Exit still works.
known_information: PowerToys 0.102.3001.0 was reported after an auto-update. The supplied Windows Error Reporting excerpt names Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll and combase.dll in Settings fault events.
A contributor asked whether Windows is up to date; the reporter has not answered.
inferences: Settings startup is a plausible shared boundary, but the diagnostics do not identify the failing initialization operation and the tray Update command has not been traced independently.
issue_context.analysis: The crash evidence does not establish a root cause or prove that the tray Update command shares the Settings failure. The open Windows-version question could materially affect the next diagnostic step.
initial_investigation: Read the issue and the maintainer's crash summary; no installed runtime test was performed.
information_gaps: Need timestamps and first-failure evidence matched to each launch command and to a clean-profile comparison.

status.label: Needs Maintainer Verification
status.detail: Correlate both tray paths with the existing Settings crash evidence before selecting a fix.
